label: G T2bars base-vs-arm
brief: Fixed captures from the game of the trainer swimming in a Tidewake sea current, seen from the normal third-person swimming camera (three views: day, day, night), plus a close crop of the on-screen current badge at full size (bottom right). Judge the interface on a 7-inch handheld screen: whether the current's direction and its strength read at a glance while swimming, and fit to the game's UI direction.
defects: The swimming current's direction cannot be read from the swimmer view at a glance on a 7-inch screen
Nothing on screen shows how strong the current is
